dedupe_keys.name: national food bank statistics south korea food and goods donated and distributed users donors and centres of the national food bank network api and yearly files

description: These data describe South Korea's national food bank network, which collects donated food and daily goods from businesses and individuals and distributes them to low-income households and welfare facilities. The network, with 17 metropolitan food banks and about 450 local food banks and food markets, is run by the Korea National Council on Social Welfare under the Ministry of Health and Welfare. An open API gives yearly statistics on users and user facilities, donors, goods received and provided by each centre, the goods donated, the centres themselves and, daily, the goods most wanted; companion files give donations by goods and donor type and provision to individuals and facilities. The data are free and available through the national public data portal, as an API returning JSON or XML after a key request that is approved automatically, and as yearly CSV files to download. Caveats: most tables are annual totals released each March for the previous year, the food bank's own statistics page did not always answer, and field-level definitions are in a guide bundled with the API. Simulation uses: estimating demand for emergency food assistance and the capacity of charitable distribution after a disaster or price shock, and mapping food bank centres against hazards. Related records: the Food Banks Canada HungerCount (data-food-banks-canada-hungercount) is a comparable national food bank source.
